reading.002.en: Ink-and-paper illustration of a four-pillar chart on a writing desk
reading.002.zh: 水墨纸本插画：书桌上摊着一张四柱命盘

reading.004.en: Every number and label here is engine output, and the rule behind it is cited beside it.
reading.004.zh: 这里的每个数字和标签都是引擎算出来的，背后的规则就写在旁边。

appjs.CHAPTERS.balance.q.en: What do you have too much or too little of?
appjs.CHAPTERS.balance.q.zh: 你的五行哪里太多，哪里太少？

appjs.CHAPTERS.timing.q.zh: 接下来会发生什么，什么时候？

appjs.CHAPTERS.space.q.en: Where should you sit, sleep and work?
appjs.CHAPTERS.space.q.zh: 你该坐哪里、睡哪里、在哪里工作？

appjs.CHART_CAP.balance.en: Your five elements, and how they feed and check each other.
appjs.CHART_CAP.balance.zh: 你的五行，以及它们如何相生相克。

appjs.CHART_CAP.drives.zh: 十神：十种经典角色，按类分组。

appjs.CHART_CAP.timing.en: Your luck pillars, decade by decade.
appjs.CHART_CAP.timing.zh: 你的大运，一步一个十年。

appjs.CHART_CAP.space.en: The eight directions for your Kua number.
appjs.CHART_CAP.space.zh: 你的命卦对应的八个方位。

appjs.PHASE_LINE.consolidation.zh: 宜先积蓄，不宜贸然冲刺。

appjs.PHASE_LINE.transition.en: Expect change at home or work.
appjs.PHASE_LINE.transition.zh: 家里或工作上会有变动。

appjs.PHASE_LINE.corrective.en: Protect health, money and close ties.
appjs.PHASE_LINE.corrective.zh: 要护好健康、钱财和身边亲近的人。

appjs.BAZHAI_EN.生氣.1.en: the best — growth, energy, opportunity; ideal for bed, desk, main door
appjs.BAZHAI_EN.生氣.1.zh: 最吉的方位：成长、精力、机会，适合放床头、书桌朝向和大门

appjs.BAZHAI_EN.天醫.1.en: health and recovery; good bedroom direction when unwell
appjs.BAZHAI_EN.天醫.1.zh: 主健康与恢复；身体不适时是不错的卧室方位

appjs.BAZHAI_EN.延年.1.en: harmony and relationships; supports couples and family bonds
appjs.BAZHAI_EN.延年.1.zh: 主和睦与人缘；有利夫妻感情和家人关系

appjs.BAZHAI_EN.伏位.1.en: calm, steady progress; suits quiet work and rest
appjs.BAZHAI_EN.伏位.1.zh: 安稳、平顺地向前；适合安静的工作和休息

appjs.BAZHAI_EN.禍害.1.en: minor troubles and friction; fine for storage or bathrooms
appjs.BAZHAI_EN.禍害.1.zh: 主小麻烦和小摩擦；放储物间或卫生间无妨

appjs.BAZHAI_EN.六煞.1.en: conflict and setbacks; avoid placing the bed here
appjs.BAZHAI_EN.六煞.1.zh: 主冲突与阻碍；床不要放在这里

appjs.BAZHAI_EN.五鬼.1.en: instability, quarrels, losses; keep activity here light
appjs.BAZHAI_EN.五鬼.1.zh: 主不稳、争吵、破财；这里少安排活动

appjs.BAZHAI_EN.絕命.1.en: the most adverse; avoid prolonged sleeping or sitting
appjs.BAZHAI_EN.絕命.1.zh: 最不利的方位；不宜在这里久睡或久坐

appjs.LEGENDS.chart.01.gloss.en: the Four Pillars: birth year·month·day·hour, each written as two characters — eight in all
appjs.LEGENDS.chart.01.gloss.zh: 四柱即出生的年、月、日、时，每柱写成两个字，一共八个字

appjs.LEGENDS.chart.02.gloss.en: the top character of a pillar is its heavenly stem, the bottom its earthly branch (with the zodiac animal)
appjs.LEGENDS.chart.02.gloss.zh: 每柱上面的字是天干，下面的字是地支（旁边标有生肖）

appjs.LEGENDS.chart.03.gloss.en: the day stem — the character that IS you; every other character is read by its relationship to it
appjs.LEGENDS.chart.03.gloss.zh: 日干，也就是代表你自己的那个字；其他每个字都按与它的关系来读

appjs.LEGENDS.chart.04.gloss.en: that relationship, named — translated god-by-god in §4
appjs.LEGENDS.chart.04.gloss.zh: 把这种关系起了名字，第 4 节逐个说明

appjs.LEGENDS.chart.05.gloss.en: hidden stems: extra elements stored inside each branch, listed under the pillar
appjs.LEGENDS.chart.05.gloss.zh: 每个地支里还藏着的其他五行，列在各柱下面

appjs.LEGENDS.chart.06.gloss.en: the zodiac animal of the birth-year branch
appjs.LEGENDS.chart.06.gloss.zh: 出生年地支对应的生肖

appjs.LEGENDS.chart.07.gloss.en: your personal trigram — decides your lucky compass directions (§7)
appjs.LEGENDS.chart.07.gloss.zh: 你个人的卦，决定你的吉方（第 7 节）

appjs.LEGENDS.chart.08.gloss.en: the life star (Nine Star, 九星) of the birth year — the number feng shui overlays use for you
appjs.LEGENDS.chart.08.gloss.zh: 出生年对应的本命星（九星），风水叠加盘里用在你身上的就是这个数字

appjs.LEGENDS.chart.09.gloss.en: an auxiliary destiny point derived from the birth month + hour — classical readers weigh it for temperament and life theme
appjs.LEGENDS.chart.09.gloss.zh: 由出生月和时辰推出的辅助命点，古法据此看性情和人生主题

appjs.LEGENDS.chart.10.gloss.en: the pillar of the estimated conception month — a supplementary root the chart can draw on
appjs.LEGENDS.chart.10.gloss.zh: 按推算的受孕月份排出的一柱，是命盘可以借用的补充根气

appjs.LEGENDS.chart.11.gloss.en: the elements that act as this chart's medicine (§5)
appjs.LEGENDS.chart.11.gloss.zh: 这张命盘用来调和偏颇的五行（第 5 节）

appjs.LEGENDS.chart.12.gloss.en: symbolic stars carried by the pillars — detailed with meanings in §9
appjs.LEGENDS.chart.12.gloss.zh: 各柱带有的象征性星曜，含义详见第 9 节

appjs.LEGENDS.chart.13.gloss.en: the pillar's melodic element — its poetic name in the 60-cycle (e.g. Sea Metal, 海中金)
appjs.LEGENDS.chart.13.gloss.zh: 这一柱的音律五行，即六十甲子里的诗意名称（如海中金）

appjs.LEGENDS.chart.14.gloss.en: the Day Master's life-stage in that branch (birth→peak→decline cycle) — vitality flavour, not a verdict
appjs.LEGENDS.chart.14.gloss.zh: 日主在该地支所处的长生阶段（生、旺、衰的循环），反映的是活力的状态，不是定论

appjs.LEGENDS.chart.15.gloss.en: the 10-year luck cycles that colour each decade (§6)
appjs.LEGENDS.chart.15.gloss.zh: 决定每十年底色的十年大运（第 6 节）

appjs.LEGENDS.1.01.term.zh: 木 / 火 / 土 / 金 / 水

appjs.LEGENDS.1.02.gloss.en: weighted count of visible + hidden characters carrying that element
appjs.LEGENDS.1.02.gloss.zh: 明面和藏干里带有该五行的字，按权重合计的数量

appjs.LEGENDS.1.03.gloss.en: balance beats abundance — the tallest bar is the heaviest, not the best
appjs.LEGENDS.1.03.gloss.zh: 平衡比多更重要：最高的那一条只说明它最重，不说明它最好

appjs.LEGENDS.1.04.gloss.en: that element's share of THIS chart; gold ring = your Day Master
appjs.LEGENDS.1.04.gloss.zh: 该五行在这张命盘中所占的比例；金色圆环标出你的日主

appjs.LEGENDS.1.05.gloss.en: the generating cycle (wood→fire→earth→metal→water) — thicker = stronger feeder
appjs.LEGENDS.1.05.gloss.zh: 相生循环（木→火→土→金→水），越粗说明供养越强

appjs.LEGENDS.1.06.gloss.en: the controlling cycle — solid red = an actual affliction in this chart (a heavy element crushing a weak one)
appjs.LEGENDS.1.06.gloss.zh: 相克循环；红色实线表示这张命盘里真实存在的克伤（偏多的五行压住偏少的五行）

appjs.LEGENDS.1.07.gloss.en: the five roles every element plays relative to the Day Master — resource, output, wealth, pressure, peers; the ten gods refine these
appjs.LEGENDS.1.07.gloss.zh: 每个五行相对日主所扮演的五种角色：印（资源）、食伤（表达）、财、官杀（压力）、比劫（同辈）；十神是对它们的细分

appjs.LEGENDS.2.01.gloss.en: the chart can afford to spend — output, wealth and pressure suit it
appjs.LEGENDS.2.01.gloss.zh: 命盘有余力可以消耗，适合食伤、财和官杀

appjs.LEGENDS.2.02.gloss.en: the chart needs feeding — support, rest and resource suit it
appjs.LEGENDS.2.02.gloss.zh: 命盘需要滋养，适合扶持、休养和印

appjs.LEGENDS.2.03.gloss.en: share of the chart on the Day Master's side
appjs.LEGENDS.2.03.gloss.zh: 命盘中站在日主这一边的比例

appjs.LEGENDS.2.04.gloss.en: the Day Master's own element hidden inside the branches — its anchoring
appjs.LEGENDS.2.04.gloss.zh: 日主自身的五行藏在地支里的部分，是它的根基

appjs.LEGENDS.3.01.gloss.en: the ten god of each pillar's visible character
appjs.LEGENDS.3.01.gloss.zh: 各柱明面上那个字的十神

appjs.LEGENDS.3.02.gloss.en: the gods of the hidden stems inside each branch

appjs.LEGENDS.3.03.gloss.en: each god's name and meaning is translated in §4's list
appjs.LEGENDS.3.03.gloss.zh: 每个十神的名称和含义，见第 4 节的列表

appjs.LEGENDS.4.01.gloss.en: Direct = the proper/conventional form of a domain, Indirect = its unconventional twin (opposite-polarity / same-polarity pairing)
appjs.LEGENDS.4.01.gloss.zh: “正”指该领域里规矩、正统的形态，“偏”指它不循常规的另一面（正为阴阳相异，偏为阴阳相同）

appjs.LEGENDS.4.02.gloss.en: share of the chart's characters classified as that god — where life's attention defaults
appjs.LEGENDS.4.02.gloss.zh: 命盘中被归为该十神的字所占的比例，也就是人生的注意力默认落在哪里

appjs.LEGENDS.4.03.gloss.en: your Day Master; the five groups around it are the five roles from §1's element wheel, refined into gods
appjs.LEGENDS.4.03.gloss.zh: 中间是你的日主；四周五组，就是第 1 节五行轮里的五种角色，再细分成十神

appjs.LEGENDS.4.04.gloss.en: colour = that group's actual element for YOUR Day Master (§1 palette); size = its share of the chart
appjs.LEGENDS.4.04.gloss.zh: 颜色是该组对你的日主而言实际对应的五行（第 1 节的配色），大小是它在命盘中所占的比例

appjs.LEGENDS.4.05.gloss.en: generating (feeding) and controlling cycles between the god groups — same cycles as §1, one level up
appjs.LEGENDS.4.05.gloss.zh: 各十神组之间的相生（供养）与相克，和第 1 节是同一套循环，只是上了一层

appjs.LEGENDS.4.06.gloss.en: each group's Direct/Indirect pair with its own share — faded = barely present
appjs.LEGENDS.4.06.gloss.zh: 每组的正、偏一对及各自的占比；颜色淡表示几乎没有

appjs.LEGENDS.4.07.gloss.en: a visible god whose element also sits in the branches is rooted (durable); visible-only is floating (shows up socially, needs backing)
appjs.LEGENDS.4.07.gloss.zh: 明面上的十神，若其五行也出现在地支里，就是有根（持久）；只在明面上就是浮（社交场合显眼，需要靠山）

appjs.LEGENDS.4.08.gloss.en: classical combinations (Eating God controls Seven Killings, Hurting Officer meets Direct Officer, …) — the gods' joint behaviour, not just their sizes
appjs.LEGENDS.4.08.gloss.zh: 经典组合（食神制七杀、伤官见正官……），看的是十神合在一起的表现，而不只是各自的大小

appjs.LEGENDS.5.01.gloss.en: favourable — the chart's medicine; carry these elements in colours, directions, fields
appjs.LEGENDS.5.01.gloss.zh: 喜用：用来调和命盘的五行；可在颜色、方位和行业上多取这些五行

appjs.LEGENDS.5.03.gloss.en: support-the-weak / restrain-the-strong: the method that picked them
appjs.LEGENDS.5.03.gloss.zh: 扶弱抑强：选出用神所用的方法

appjs.LEGENDS.5.04.gloss.en: seasonal climate cross-check (a winter chart may need fire regardless)
appjs.LEGENDS.5.04.gloss.zh: 按季节寒暖做的核对（冬天出生的命盘，往往无论如何都需要火）

appjs.LEGENDS.6.01.gloss.en: one pillar per decade of life, starting from the month pillar
appjs.LEGENDS.6.01.gloss.zh: 每十年一柱，从月柱起排

appjs.LEGENDS.6.02.gloss.en: your age span under that pillar
appjs.LEGENDS.6.02.gloss.zh: 你在这一柱运下的年龄段

appjs.LEGENDS.6.03.gloss.en: the decade's dominant themes, in §4's vocabulary
appjs.LEGENDS.6.03.gloss.zh: 这十年的主要主题，沿用第 4 节的说法

appjs.LEGENDS.6.04.gloss.en: the decade you are in now

appjs.LEGENDS.7.01.gloss.en: eight-house school: your trigram splits the compass into 4 green (use) and 4 red (avoid) directions
appjs.LEGENDS.7.01.gloss.zh: 八宅派：你的命卦把罗盘分成 4 个宜用的方位（绿）和 4 个宜避的方位（红）

appjs.LEGENDS.7.02.gloss.en: green = bed headboard, desk facing, main door; red = fine for storage/bathroom
appjs.LEGENDS.7.02.gloss.zh: 绿色方位用于床头、书桌朝向和大门；红色方位放储物间或卫生间都可以

appjs.LEGENDS.7.03.gloss.en: this map differs per person — a couple can have opposite maps
appjs.LEGENDS.7.03.gloss.zh: 这张方位图每个人不一样，夫妻两人的图可能正好相反

appjs.LEGENDS.8.01.gloss.en: starts at a neutral 50; every chip is a rule that moved it
appjs.LEGENDS.8.01.gloss.zh: 从中性的 50 分起步，每个标签都是一条改变了分数的规则

appjs.LEGENDS.8.03.gloss.zh: 值得有意识去支持的方面

appjs.LEGENDS.8.04.gloss.en: the audit trail — hover none, they are the working
appjs.LEGENDS.8.04.gloss.zh: 推演依据：这几项没有悬停说明，它们本身就是推演过程

appjs.LEGENDS.8.05.gloss.en: the domain's signal god actually resides in its primary palace — a seated signal lands harder than share alone suggests
appjs.LEGENDS.8.05.gloss.zh: 该领域的关键十神确实坐在它的主宫位里，所以比单看占比更有分量

appjs.LEGENDS.8.06.gloss.en: the wealth-element storage branch (Chen, Xu, Chou, Wei): open = accumulation compounds; sealed = opens in its clash years (§13); absent = wealth flows, systems must do the storing
appjs.LEGENDS.8.06.gloss.zh: 财星五行所入的库支（辰、戌、丑、未）：库已开，财会越积越多；库封着，要等逢冲之年才打开（见第 13 节）；无库，财来财去，要靠固定的储蓄机制来存

appjs.LEGENDS.9.01.gloss.en: symbolic stars: classical stem-branch patterns, flavour on top of structure
appjs.LEGENDS.9.01.gloss.zh: 神煞：经典的天干地支组合，是命盘结构之上的点缀

appjs.LEGENDS.9.02.term.zh: 年柱 / 月柱 / 日柱 / 时柱标记

appjs.LEGENDS.9.02.gloss.en: which pillar carries it — ancestry · career/parents · self/spouse · children/later life
appjs.LEGENDS.9.02.gloss.zh: 落在哪一柱：祖上 · 事业与父母 · 自己与配偶 · 子女与晚年

appjs.LEGENDS.10.01.gloss.en: read straight off §4's distribution — the basis column shows the exact threshold
appjs.LEGENDS.10.01.gloss.zh: 直接取自第 4 节的分布，“依据”一列写着确切的阈值

appjs.LEGENDS.10.02.gloss.en: a legitimate result, not a failure
appjs.LEGENDS.10.02.gloss.zh: 这也是正常的结果，不是没算出来

appjs.LEGENDS.11.01.gloss.en: traditional five-element medicine correspondence — reference, not medical advice
appjs.LEGENDS.11.01.gloss.zh: 传统五行医学的对应关系，仅供参考，不是医疗建议

appjs.LEGENDS.11.02.gloss.en: flags an element too weak or too heavy to lean on
appjs.LEGENDS.11.02.gloss.zh: 标出偏少或偏多、靠不住的五行

appjs.LEGENDS.12.01.gloss.en: how efficiently effort converts to reward in that field
appjs.LEGENDS.12.01.gloss.zh: 在这个领域里，努力换来回报的效率有多高

appjs.LEGENDS.12.02.gloss.en: low-ranked fields cost more energy here — never forbidden
appjs.LEGENDS.12.02.gloss.zh: 排名靠后的领域在这里要多花力气，但绝不是禁区

appjs.LEGENDS.13.01.gloss.en: a supportive year for that life dimension
appjs.LEGENDS.13.01.gloss.zh: 对这个人生领域有利的一年

appjs.LEGENDS.13.02.gloss.en: navigate deliberately — a note, never a verdict
appjs.LEGENDS.13.02.gloss.zh: 走得稳一点就好，这只是提示，不是定论

appjs.LEGENDS.13.03.gloss.zh: 没有触发什么特别的事

appjs.LEGENDS.13.04.gloss.en: the decade sets the climate, the year the weather
appjs.LEGENDS.13.04.gloss.zh: 大运定气候，流年定天气

appjs.LEGENDS.13.05.gloss.zh: 桃花：主感情与人缘被激活的地支

appjs.TG_GIST.食神.zh: 温和的表达，享受与从容

appjs.TG_GIST.傷官.en: sharp output and a will to challenge

appjs.TG_GIST.正財.zh: 稳定的财富：薪水与积蓄

appjs.TG_GIST.正官.zh: 正当的权威、规矩与地位

appjs.TG_GIST.偏印.zh: 不拘一格的学习与独自钻研

appjs.TG_GIST.正印.zh: 滋养与扶持，学业与庇护

appjs.renderPerson.008.en: Strategy: {SEC_ZH_n} — what this asks of you

appjs.renderPerson.015.en: {who} Your reading (命书)

appjs.stratBlock.002.en: Monthly rhythm (recurring every year): green months feed this chart, red months drain it — schedule pushes into green months, recovery into red ones.
appjs.stratBlock.002.zh: 月度节奏（每年重复）：绿色的月份滋养这张命盘，红色的月份消耗它，冲刺安排在绿色月份，休整安排在红色月份。

appjs.stratBlock.006.zh: 合伙与友情的相处模式

appjs.stratBlock.011.en: none flagged in the next decade
appjs.stratBlock.011.zh: 未来十年没有被标出的年份

appjs.stratBlock.013.zh: 偏体制的依据：{s_corp_ev} · 偏波动的依据：{s_vent_ev}

appjs.stratBlock.016.en: no wealth-activation years in the next decade — build, don't chase
appjs.stratBlock.016.zh: 未来十年没有财星被激活的年份：先打基础，不要追逐

appjs.pIdentity.001.en: This is your day pillar: you, at every age. Each stage of life has its own side, shown below; you are now in {year_your}.
appjs.pIdentity.001.zh: 这是你的日柱：不论哪个年纪，都是你。人生每个阶段各有一面，见下方；现在是 {year_your}。

appjs.pIdentity.006.en: This is your day pillar: you, at every age. Each stage of life has its own side, shown below.
appjs.pIdentity.006.zh: 这是你的日柱：不论哪个年纪，都是你。人生每个阶段各有一面，见下方。

appjs.synthNote.005.en: The full report, in classical terms

appjs.buildPillars.008.zh: 弧线连着地支有相互作用的各柱。琥珀色虚线是害、刑、冲，绿色实线是合。要结合宫位来读：年柱和月柱之间的张力，牵涉祖上和事业；日柱代表自己和配偶。{its_length}

appjs.buildPillars.009.en: Columns: 神煞 symbolic star · 柱 pillar (年 year, 月 month, 日 day, 时 hour) · 吉忌 helps (吉) or asks for care (忌)
appjs.buildPillars.009.zh: 各列：神煞，象征性的星煞；柱，所在之柱（年、月、日、时）；吉忌，吉（吉）表示有帮助，忌（忌）表示要留意。

appjs.buildPillars.015.en: ; {part_neg} in your {PEN_neg} pillar asks for care: {part_neg_2}.
appjs.buildPillars.015.zh: ；{part_neg} 落在你的 {PEN_neg} 柱，需要留意：{part_neg_2}。

appjs.buildPillars.016.en: , and no star asks for care.

appjs.buildPillars.018.en: Symbolic stars (神煞) are classical patterns read from the stems and branches; they add flavour on top of the chart's structure and never override the balance reading.
appjs.buildPillars.018.zh: 神煞是依据天干地支读出的经典格局，用来给命盘结构添些细节，从不凌驾于强弱平衡的判断之上。

appjs.buildPillars.020.zh: 这份解读引用的全部规则

appjs.buildElements.001.en:
单位 = 字重，不是个数：天干各 1.0、地支本气 1.0、余气 1/3，全盘合计 {wtot_toFixed}。
      Units are weighted character counts: each stem 1.0, each branch's main hidden stem 1.0, each minor hidden stem 1/3.
appjs.buildElements.001.zh: 单位按字的权重计，不是数个数：每个天干 1.0，每个地支的本气 1.0，余气各 1/3，全盘合计 {wtot_toFixed}。

appjs.buildElements.003.zh: {elb_pr}{elw_pr} 对你压力最大（{pr_share}%）；{elb_rs}{elw_rs} 滋养你 {pr_share_2}{rs_share}%，{pr_share_3}。

appjs.buildElements.008.en: 五行关系 — the five relations, listed{eflowsList_c}

appjs.buildElements.010.zh: 扶持占比{st_support_ratio}% 根气占比{st_root_ratio}% {st_formation_status}

appjs.buildElements.011.en: {weak_Weak} ({st_score}) — {sp_the}{stage_stage}, not which element has the biggest bar.
appjs.buildElements.011.zh: {weak_Weak}（{st_score}）：定强弱的是 {sp_the}{stage_stage}，而不是哪个五行的柱子最高。

appjs.buildElements.017.zh: {elb_topSup}{topSup_zh}{elw_topSup} 扶持最多（{topSup_w}）：扶持 {pt_support}{pt_support_2} 泄耗 {pt_drain}，{weak_pt}。

appjs.buildElements.018.en: yet the season still tips it weak

appjs.buildElements.019.en: yet the season still carries it strong

appjs.buildElements.024.en: Formation check: {st_formation_detail}. Support ratio = share of the chart feeding the Day Master; root mass = share of hidden stems carrying its element.
appjs.buildElements.024.zh: 成格检查：{st_formation_detail}。扶持占比是命盘中扶持日主的部分所占的比例；根气占比是藏干中带有日主五行的部分所占的比例。

appjs.buildElements.029.en: {elb_excess} {elw_excess} excess ({excess_share}%) — watch {excess_organs}; {excess_aspects} is the pattern to notice.
appjs.buildElements.029.zh: {elb_excess}{elw_excess} 过旺（{excess_share}%）：留意 {excess_organs}；{excess_aspects} 是需要留意的表现。

appjs.buildElements.031.en: All five elements sit in range — no organ system is flagged.
appjs.buildElements.031.zh: 五行都在正常范围内，没有需要特别提示的脏腑系统。

appjs.buildGods.004.en: The five circles are the ten roles in five groups; a bigger circle is a bigger share of your chart. The centre is you, the Day Master (日元).
appjs.buildGods.004.zh: 五个圆圈是分成五组的十神；圆圈越大，在你命盘里占的比例越大。中心是你自己，也就是日主。

appjs.buildGods.005.en: Solid green arrows: each group feeds the next. Dashed red arrows: each group checks the one it points at.
appjs.buildGods.005.zh: 绿色实线箭头：每一组生下一组。红色虚线箭头：每一组克它所指的那一组。

appjs.buildGods.017.en: Each bar is how much of your chart one role takes up. A role is what a character is to you, the Day Master.
appjs.buildGods.017.zh: 每一条表示某个角色在你命盘中所占的比例。所谓角色，是某个字相对于日主（也就是你）的身份。

appjs.buildGods.018.en: Bands: 20% or more is prominent, 8% or more is present, under 8% is faint, 0% is absent.
appjs.buildGods.018.zh: 档位：20%以上为突出，8%以上为具备，不足8%为微弱，0%为缺失。

appjs.buildGods.021.en: {sharp_verdict} — {sharp_metrics} make up {sharp_metrics_2}% of your chart, your sharpest trait.
appjs.buildGods.021.zh: {sharp_verdict}：{sharp_metrics} 合计占你命盘的 {sharp_metrics_2}%，是你最鲜明的特质。

appjs.buildGods.022.en: No strong tendency on any axis — a balanced profile, not a failure.
appjs.buildGods.022.zh: 没有哪个维度的倾向特别强，这是一份均衡的画像，不是缺点。

appjs.buildGods.025.en: No classical pair pattern triggers — the gods operate independently in this chart.
appjs.buildGods.025.zh: 没有触发经典的组合格局，这张命盘里各个十神各自独立起作用。

appjs.buildGods.027.en: {godc_dm} ({bad_pct}%) carries an unfavourable element ({elc_bad}) — use it deliberately, budget recovery.
appjs.buildGods.027.zh: {godc_dm}（{bad_pct}%）的五行（{elc_bad}）属忌：用时要有分寸，并留出恢复的时间。

appjs.buildGods.028.en: {godc_dm} ({good_pct}%) carries {elc_good}, one of your 用神 — a clean engine; using it strengthens the chart.
appjs.buildGods.028.zh: {godc_dm}（{good_pct}%）带的是 {elc_good}，属于你的用神之一：这是一台干净的引擎，用好它会让命盘更稳。

appjs.buildGods.029.en: The heavy gods sit outside both lists — structure is neutral here.
appjs.buildGods.029.zh: 最重的几个十神既不在喜用的名单里，也不在忌的名单里，这里的结构是中性的。

appjs.buildGods.030.zh: {ti_favor_length} 个主导十神中有 {ti_favor} 个

appjs.buildGods.032.en: Three checks a percentage chart cannot make: is the heavy god aligned with your 用神, is it rooted in the branches, and what do the gods form together. Personality is not static: the current decade (时运 tab) overlays its own gods.
appjs.buildGods.032.zh: 百分比图表做不到的三项检查：最重的十神是否与你的用神一致，它在地支里有没有根，以及各个十神合在一起形成什么格局。性格不是一成不变的：当前大运（时运页）会叠加它自己的十神。

appjs.buildGods.043.en: Columns: 领域 life area · 分 score out of 100 (50 is neutral) · 十神 the roles that govern it, with their share of your chart · 得位 ✓ when those roles sit in the area's own pillar
appjs.buildGods.043.zh: 各列：领域，人生领域；分，百分制得分（50为中性）；十神，主管该领域的十神及其在命盘中的占比；得位，这些十神落在该领域对应的柱位时标 ✓。

appjs.buildGods.044.en: {n_split} ({n_split_2}): a signal only, with no score of its own.
appjs.buildGods.044.zh: {n_split}（{n_split_2}）：只是一个信号，没有自己的分数。

appjs.buildGods.045.zh: 人生领域：得分、信号、落位

appjs.buildGods.046.en: {top_en} stands highest among charts, with a score of {top_score}; your heaviest signal is {heavyName_toLowerCase} — {heavy}%, {inPal_heavy} {heavy_2}.
appjs.buildGods.046.zh: {top_en} 的位次在命盘中最高，得分 {top_score}；你最重的信号是 {heavyName_toLowerCase}，占 {heavy}%，{inPal_heavy}{heavy_2}。

appjs.buildGods.048.en: Each score starts at a neutral 50; every rule listed under the table moved it by the amount shown.
appjs.buildGods.048.zh: 每项得分都从中性的 50 分起算；表格下方列出的每条规则，都按所示的数值对它做了增减。

appjs.buildGods.058.en: No field stands out for this chart.
appjs.buildGods.058.zh: 这张命盘没有特别突出的行业方向。

appjs.buildGods.059.en: Fields and roles are ranked by how well their element matches the elements that help you, and by how they suit your leading roles. A low-ranked field costs more energy here; it is never forbidden.
appjs.buildGods.059.zh: 行业和角色按两点排序：所属五行与对你有帮助的五行有多契合，以及与你主导的十神有多相配。排名靠后的方向在这里会更耗精力，但绝不是禁区。

appjs.buildTiming.002.en: Each card: the ages, the decade's pillar (stem over branch), its phase, the two roles it brings, and what those roles mean.
appjs.buildTiming.002.zh: 每张卡片：年龄范围、这步大运的干支（上干下支）、所处阶段、它带来的两个十神，以及这些十神的含义。

appjs.buildTiming.010.zh: 这是命盘排出的最后一步大运。

appjs.buildTiming.030.en: The two cards are the energies currently overlaid on the birth chart — the active 10-year luck pillar and this year's pillar — labelled with their ten gods relative to this Day Master.
appjs.buildTiming.030.zh: 这两张卡片是当前叠加在出生命盘上的两股能量：正在行的十年大运，和今年的流年柱，并标出了它们相对这位日主的十神。

appjs.buildTiming.033.zh: 顺的月份：{ranges_good}（{gel}）。{ranges_bad} 要放慢节奏。

appjs.buildTiming.034.en: No month carries your medicine — pace the whole year evenly.
appjs.buildTiming.034.zh: 没有哪个月份的五行是你的用神，全年平稳安排即可。

appjs.buildTiming.035.en: Each solar month carries a branch and its element. Months whose element is your medicine are marked good; months carrying a 忌神 element are marked to pace. The rhythm is the same every year — the 流年 table says which years lift or lower it.
appjs.buildTiming.035.zh: 每个节气月都带一个地支和它的五行。五行是你的用神的月份，标为顺；带有忌神五行的月份，标为要放慢。这套节奏每年都一样，哪些年份会抬高或压低它，要看流年表。

appjs.buildCompass.002.en: Face {dirOf} (Vitality) for bed and desk; keep long sitting out of {dirOf_2} (Severed Fate).
appjs.buildCompass.002.zh: 床和书桌朝向{dirOf}（生气）；久坐的位置避开{dirOf_2}（绝命）。

appjs.buildCompass.004.en: Two layers: 八宅 grades ORIENTATION — where to face and head long-stay activities; 用神 grades ELEMENT CONTENT — what colours, materials and fields feed the chart. A green direction whose element is unfavourable is still a good direction to FACE — furnish it in the 用神 palette. 命卦 comes from the birth year alone; the 用神 layer is the personal one.
appjs.buildCompass.004.zh: 两个层面：八宅评定的是朝向，也就是人面朝哪里、床头和久留之处怎么定；用神评定的是五行内容，也就是什么颜色、材质和行业能滋养命盘。一个方位即使是绿色吉方、五行却对你不利，仍然是值得面朝的好方位，只要用用神的色系来布置。命卦只由出生年份决定，用神这一层才是因人而异的。

appjs.buildCompass.009.en: east wall, plants and timber, green accents
appjs.buildCompass.009.zh: 东墙，植物与木质陈设，绿色点缀

appjs.buildCompass.010.en: south wall, warm light, red/orange accent
appjs.buildCompass.010.zh: 南墙，暖色灯光，红色或橙色点缀

appjs.buildCompass.011.en: centre or SW/NE, ceramics and stone, yellow/brown tones
appjs.buildCompass.011.zh: 中宫或西南、东北，陶瓷与石材，黄色或棕色调

appjs.buildCompass.012.en: west wall, metal frames and white/gold
appjs.buildCompass.012.zh: 西墙，金属边框，白色或金色

appjs.buildCompass.013.en: north wall, glass or a water feature, blue/black
appjs.buildCompass.013.zh: 北墙，玻璃或水景，蓝色或黑色

appjs.buildCompass.017.en: Add {elw_fav} ({elc_fav}){colEn_in} through lighting or an accent wall; keep {unf_map} ({unf_map_2}) out of your main room.
appjs.buildCompass.017.zh: 用灯光或一面主题墙补入 {elw_fav}（{elc_fav}）{colEn_in}；主要房间里少放 {unf_map}（{unf_map_2}）。

appjs.buildCompass.022.en: Technique: 扶抑 supports a weak chart or restrains a strong one; 调候 corrects its season — for this chart, add {fav_map}, keep {unf_map} light.
appjs.buildCompass.022.zh: 用的方法：扶抑是命弱就扶、命强就抑；调候是按出生季节的寒热燥湿来调。就这张命盘而言，宜补{fav_map}，{unf_map}宜少。

appjs.buildCompass.023.en: In god vocabulary: your 用神 {fav_map} — those life-areas ARE the medicine.
appjs.buildCompass.023.zh: 用十神的话说：你的用神是{fav_map}，这些人生领域正是用神所在。

appjs.buildCompass.028.en: the star or branch that decides it
appjs.buildCompass.028.zh: 起决定作用的星或地支

appjs.buildCompass.029.en: Bed head to the {bed_dir} ({bed_star}), desk facing {desk_dir} ({desk_star}).

appjs.buildCompass.033.en: Long-stay items follow the 八宅 stars of your 命卦: 天醫 for the bed, 生氣 for desk and door, 延年 for the couples' bed, 伏位 for a quiet room. The three corners are personal 神煞 — 文昌 by day stem, 桃花 and 驛馬 by the year-branch trine — mapped to their palace.
appjs.buildCompass.033.zh: 久待的位置按命卦的八宅星来定：床取天医，书桌和门取生气，夫妻床取延年，安静的房间取伏位。另外三个方位是个人神煞：文昌按日干定，桃花和驿马按年支三合定，各落在对应的宫位。

appjs.buildCompass.034.en: A direction is where the head or face points; when the room cannot allow the first choice, take the next favourable star, never an unfavourable one.
appjs.buildCompass.034.zh: 这里的方向，指床头或面部所朝的方向；房间容不下首选时，就取下一个吉星，不要取凶星。

appjs.buildCompass.039.en: None of this year's afflictions sits on your four favourable sectors.
appjs.buildCompass.039.zh: 今年的煞位，没有一个落在你的四个吉方。

appjs.pRelations.002.en: No strong pulls between your pillars.
appjs.pRelations.002.zh: 你的四柱之间没有强烈的拉扯。

appjs.pRoom.001.en: Room plan with north at the top: {Object_entries}

appjs.pSlimGrid.001.en: Top: the role each stem plays for you. Bottom: the stems hidden in each branch.
appjs.pSlimGrid.001.zh: 上排：各天干对你而言扮演的角色。下排：每个地支里藏的天干。

appjs.bazhaiCompass.001.en: Eight directions, north at the top: {rows_map}

appjs.dailyFig.002.en: Best day this month for {B_for}: {B_date} {B_gz} ({B_officer} day).

appjs.dailyFig.003.en: No clear best day this month.
appjs.dailyFig.003.zh: 本月没有特别突出的吉日。

appjs.dailyFig.008.en: Columns: 日期 date · 日柱 day pillar (with its day officer) · 十神 the roles the day brings you · 五行 the day's element (用 useful to you, 忌 to avoid) · {actZh_map}
appjs.dailyFig.008.zh: 各列：日期为公历日期；日柱为当日干支（附建除十二神）；十神是这一天带给你的角色；五行是当日的五行（用对你有帮助，忌宜避）；{actZh_map}

appjs.dailyFig.010.en: ◉ good · ⚠ avoid · · neutral — per activity, hover a cell for the deciding rule.
appjs.dailyFig.010.zh: ◉ 吉 · ⚠ 忌 · · 平，按事项分列；将鼠标悬停在格子上，可看到起决定作用的规则。

appjs.dailyFig.011.en: Twelve day officers Completion, Open and Settle are good for most acts; Remove suits treatment; Close and Danger hold back travel and moving; Break (and any day that clashes the month) is avoided for everything.
appjs.dailyFig.011.zh: 建除十二神：成、开、定对大多数事都吉；除宜治病；闭、危不利出行和搬家；破（以及与月支相冲的日子）万事皆避。

appjs.dailyFig.012.en: Your branches a day branch that clashes your day branch ({elc_c}) or year branch ({elc_c_2}) is avoided for marriage, moving and launches; a Six Combination with your day branch favours marriage and signing; a Harm holds back medical.
appjs.dailyFig.012.zh: 你的地支：与你的日支（{elc_c}）或年支（{elc_c_2}）相冲的日子，不宜结婚、搬家和开业；与你的日支六合，利于结婚和签约；逢害的日子，不宜就医。

appjs.dailyFig.013.en: Element of the day a day stem carrying your primary useful god favours launches and signing; one carrying your chief avoided element is avoided for banking and launches.
appjs.dailyFig.013.zh: 当日五行：日干属你的首要用神，利于开业和签约；日干属你最忌的五行，不宜办银行事务和开业。

appjs.gejuPlain.002.en: Chart structure (格局). Your month branch (月令) is {br}, and its main stem (本气) is {st}, {god}.

appjs.gejuPlain.003.en: {tou} also shows among your visible stems (透干), so the chart works as a {god} structure ({tou_2}).
appjs.gejuPlain.003.zh: {tou} 也透在你的天干上（透干），所以这张命盘成 {god} 格（{tou_2}）。

appjs.gejuPlain.004.en: None of the month's hidden stems shows among your visible stems (透干), so the chart works from that ruling stem (司令), with the visible stems as the actors.
appjs.gejuPlain.004.zh: 月令所藏的天干，没有一个透出在你的天干上，也就是不透干，所以命盘以当令的那个天干（司令）为主，天干上露出的字只是配角。

appjs.eflowsList.001.en:
How every other element relates to
      YOUR Day Master {elb_er} — the same five roles the ten gods (十神 tab) are built from:
appjs.eflowsList.001.zh: 其他各个五行与你的日主（{elb_er}）是什么关系，这五种角色正是十神（见十神标签页）的来源：

appjs.eflowsList.002.en: (this share is the Day Master's own element — as ten-god 比肩/劫財 peers the chart counts 0%)
appjs.eflowsList.002.zh: （这一份是日主自身的五行；换成十神里的比肩、劫财来看，命盘中占0%）

appjs.supportDrain.001.en: Supporting (same kind) vs draining (other kinds) — the score's own numbers
appjs.supportDrain.001.zh: 扶持（同类）与泄耗（异类）：这就是得分用到的数字

appjs.supportDrain.004.zh: 得分 = 得令{pt_season_pts}{pt_season_pts_2} + 2 × (扶持{pt_support} − 泄耗{pt_drain}) / 总量{pt_total} + 通根{pt_root_pts}{pt_root_pts_2} = {c_strength_score} → {c_strength_verdict}

appjs.tiaohouStrip.003.en: Seasonal adjustment the {elc_c} month asks for {chips} — {t_verdict} with the support-and-restrain verdict above
appjs.tiaohouStrip.003.zh: 调候：{elc_c}月需要{chips}，与上面扶抑的结论{t_verdict}。

appjs.pillarGrid.001.en: Read each column top to bottom: the role the stem plays for you, the stem, the branch, the stems hidden in the branch, its life stage and its sound element. Year is on the right, as in a classical chart; your own column, 日, is outlined. Tap any character for its meaning.
appjs.pillarGrid.001.zh: 每一列从上往下读：天干对你扮演的角色、天干、地支、地支里的藏干、十二长生的阶段和纳音五行。年柱在最右，与经典命盘一致；你自己的那一列是日柱，用框标出。点任意一个字可以看它的含义。

appjs.interactionsLine.001.en: No 合冲刑害 among your four branches — the pillars sit quietly with each other.
appjs.interactionsLine.001.zh: 你的四个地支之间没有合冲刑害，各柱之间相安无事。

appjs.interactionsLine.013.zh: 只是轻微摩擦，不至于破裂

appjs.pSeal.001.en: Your four pillars, year to hour: {PILLAR_KEYS_map}

appjs.zhNote.001.en: The Chinese version of this section is coming soon.
appjs.zhNote.001.zh: 此部分的中文版本即将推出

appjs.buildGods.060.en: Standing under a score is where that score sits among a fixed reference sample of 10,000 fictional charts ({v}), from 0 to 100. It is a relative standing among charts, not strength. The score itself is unchanged.
appjs.buildGods.060.zh: 分数下方的位次，是该分数在固定参照样本（{v}，1 万张虚构命盘）中所处的位置，范围 0 到 100。这是在众多命盘中的相对位次，不代表强弱；分数本身不变。

appjs.pBalance.001.en: {EL_EN_top} leads your chart at {top_share}%, heavier than {st_n} in 100 charts.
appjs.pBalance.001.zh: {EL_EN_top}在你的命盘中最旺，占{top_share}%，比100张命盘中的{st_n}张更重。

appjs.pBalance.002.en: {EL_EN_top} leads your chart at {top_share}%, lighter than {st_n} in 100 charts.
appjs.pBalance.002.zh: {EL_EN_top}在你的命盘中最旺，占{top_share}%，比100张命盘中的{st_n}张更轻。

appjs.pBalance.004.en: {EL_EN_H} is what helps you most, and {Y_y} reads as a {Y_word}.
appjs.pBalance.004.zh: 对你帮助最大的是{EL_EN_H}，{Y_y}年是{Y_word}。
